assignments.package_label_en: Tzedakah and Breaking the Lust for Money
assignments.reason: Breaking the lust for money (שבירת תאות ממון) is the defining action of the tzedakah domain. The package itself is named after this very concept: 'Tzedakah and Breaking the Lust for Money.' Its essential nature is the active face of tzedakah — the practical expression of generous spirit in overcoming the desire for wealth. The source text (section א) places it inseparably within the tzedakah domain: 'שבירתה הוא על ידי צדקה' — its breaking IS through tzedakah. While it produces effects in other packages (hashgachah, chesed), the concept itself is defined by what it is: the antidote-action belonging to the tzedakah/generosity domain.

Complete divine providence (השגחה שלמה) is essentially the power of divine sight. In Torah #13, the Torah IS re'iyah (sight/vision): 'התורה היא טנת"א שהם תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין' (section ד). Hashgachah is the force of divine seeing that the Torah brings into the world: 'כשחכם מביא תורה, נמצא שמביא כח הראות של השגחת השם יתברך עלינו' (section ד). Its essential nature is sight — the very quality that defines the Torah-Merkavah package, where תורה = ראיה. Providence is the divine gaze; Torah is the instrument of that gaze. They share the same essential domain: the power of vision.

The cancellation of divine anger (נתבטל החרון אף) belongs to the chesed domain by essential nature. In the source text (section ב), the removal of anger and the flow of chesed are presented as a single unified transition: 'וכפי הביטול של עבודה זרה זאת כן נתבטל החרון אף... ונתמשך חסד בעולם, בבחינת ועושה חסד למשיחו'. The cancellation of anger IS the clearing-away of what blocks chesed — it is the negative-space definition of the chesed domain. When charon af departs, what remains is chesed. The verse 'ruach apeinu mashiach Hashem' ties this to the same divine-name/chesed structure. Its essential nature is not the anger itself (which would be evil) but its removal, which is a chesed-domain event.

The drawing of chesed into the world (נתמשך חסד בעולם) IS chesed in its active, flowing expression. Its essential nature is identical to the core concept of Package 4: chesed. The source text (section ב) states: 'ונתמשך חסד בעולם בבחינת ועושה חסד למשיחו'. This is not merely an effect that touches chesed — it IS the chesed of the divine name flowing into the world, the very quality that defines the Chesed-and-Havayot package. It belongs alongside חסד, חסדים, הויות, and אתרא עמיקי, all of which are expressions of the same divine mercy dimension.

assignments.package_label_en: Tzedakah and Breaking the Lust for Money
assignments.reason: The generous spirit (רוח נדיבה) is explicitly equated with tzedakah in the source text (section א): 'רוחא זה בחינת צדקה שהיא רוח נדיבה'. While the node_id 'רוח' (the broader concept of spirit/wind) already exists in Package 5 via a bechina edge, 'רוח נדיבה' is a more specific form appearing in an eitza edge. Its essential nature is the spirit of generosity — the animating quality of tzedakah itself. It is the tzedakah-domain concept par excellence: the inner disposition that produces the cooling of money-lust. It belongs alongside צדקה, רוח, יעקב, and משא ומתן באמונה, all of which express the generous/contented orientation that opposes avarice.
